# Adrafteo

## Overview
Adrafteo is a web application for resellers who want to save reusable marketplace listing templates, fill in product variables, and copy polished adverts for platforms like Vinted, eBay, Depop, and other marketplaces.

## Main site
- https://adrafteo.com/

## Purpose
Adrafteo helps marketplace sellers create reusable title and description templates, replace variables such as brand, size, condition, or price, and generate ready-to-post listings without writing the full text from scratch each time.

## Primary user value
- Save reusable listing templates
- Fill variables and cross-variable defaults
- Generate clean marketplace adverts
- Track inventory, purchase value, target sale value, realised sales, and profit

## Key public pages
- https://adrafteo.com/
- https://adrafteo.com/robots.txt
- https://adrafteo.com/sitemap.xml

## Important note
This service is a user-authenticated web tool. The app stores user templates and inventory data in Supabase and is intended to help a single user or a small personal user base work efficiently with marketplace adverts.
